_interface.source_anchor: For non-image Scholar View bind representation_id and evidence_id to the actual primary source in source-integrity.json; supply sections.supplied_text exactly, no photographed diplomatic or physical apparatus, and a governed PARTIAL outcome with visible unavailable-image limitations. Image tasks retain exact locus/image and E-SUPPLIED-PAGE binding.
_interface.literal_unicode: Use literal UTF-8 scholarly text. Do not hand-encode ordinary text with remembered Unicode escape sequences.

entity_contract.page_referent_field_rule: explicit_page_name uses page_name_form; independently_verified uses page_token plus identification_evidence_ids; inferred/unresolved use the visible page_token that prompted the inference.

comparator_characterization_contract.completed_requires: witness_comparison.comparisons[]: supplied_text, comparator_text, evidence_id, characterization; the comparator evidence records the exact inspected_passage.
comparator_characterization_contract.orthographic_only: Conservative token equality after case, accent, long-s, u/v, i/j, and ligature normalization; never infer semantic equivalence. An orthography-only claim across a passage requires comparison_scope: entire_claimed_passage, claimed_passage copied from the supplied transcription, and full matching comparator evidence; every comparison must be orthographic_only.

analytical_claim_contract.entity_markers_in_text: Supported. Registered {{entity:ENTITY-ID}} markers are resolved before claim validation and recorded as entity_ids.
analytical_claim_contract.claim_marker_semantics: {{claim:CLAIM-ID}} expands to the full rendered claim text. Use the marker as the claim phrase or sentence, not as a citation after duplicate prose.

foreign_language_token_contract.optional_alternate_forms: alternate_forms may list diacritic-only alternatives for the same underlying letter sequence. They are aliases of one token record, not additional supplied-page witnesses or separate lexemes.
foreign_language_token_contract.alternate_form_rule: Every alternate form must reduce to exactly the same underlying letters as form after Unicode decomposition and removal of combining marks.
foreign_language_token_contract.evidence_role_rule: reading_evidence_ids establish form or reading; gloss_evidence_ids establish meaning. Translation evidence may support a gloss but does not establish the supplied-page glyph.

long_s_review_contract.reviewed_against_supplied_image: Set true only after a supplied-image s/f review and after visually adjudicating every item that --prepare-long-s reports as requiring review.
long_s_review_contract.checklist_file: Automatically located in the selected task directory; omit this field from long_s_review.
long_s_review_contract.ownership: The helper derives token IDs, ordering, normalized pairings, and ordinary resolution categories. Do not hand-populate the checklist.
long_s_review_contract.workflow: Run --prepare-long-s. If manual_review_required is nonzero, inspect only those reported cross-layer s/f mismatches against the supplied image, correct diplomatic or normalized text, and rerun. The prepared checklist hashes bind review to the exact diplomatic and normalized Latin. Unrelated non-Latin edits do not invalidate it; a Latin edit requires --prepare-long-s again.

textual_uncertainty_contract.model_authors: Concrete non-foreign textual uncertainties only; use [] when none are present.
textual_uncertainty_contract.foreign_reading_status: Do not restate foreign-token certainty in free prose. The adapter derives a canonical summary from foreign_language_tokens[].reading_status.

_interface.selected_claim_ids_contract: Identity selection only. Ordinary WORK_ESTABLISHED Scholar View should leave selected_claim_ids empty; the helper adds the work-identity claim automatically. Analytical claims are selected by actual {{claim:CLAIM-ID}} marker use and do not belong in selected_claim_ids.
_interface.analytical_quote_rule: Quotation marks in analytical sections are reserved for literal supplied-page wording. English glosses or paraphrases should be unquoted or rendered through a licensed analytical claim; the preflight reports all currently detectable quoted-form problems together.
_interface.validation_diagnostics: Final completion runs an aggregate preflight first and reports independent current blockers together where dependencies permit; fix the reported batch before rerunning.
_interface.rare_book_rule: Visible features may be described directly. Explicit functional language such as used for, serves as, functions as, keyed to, or cross-referencing must be rendered through a typed feature_function analytical claim. Bibliographical format (folio/quarto/etc.), binding history, provenance, or other non-visible conclusions require separately licensed evidence; apparent physical size does not establish bibliographical format.

evidence.inspected_passage: Exact passage copied from inspected witness.

analytical_claim.text: The inspected comparator has the same reading.

publication_contract.review: Carry actual distinct-pass attestation; the adapter never invents review.
publication_contract.entities: Resolve names in the reviewed payload and bind entity_ids; standalone entities never license a sentence.
publication_contract.terminal: DESIGN_R_PUBLISHER_SELECTED / RELAY_COMMITTED_RESPONSE_AND_STOP; one bound Read only in READ_COMMITTED_FILE mode
publication_contract.retained_scope: Research delta retains source accounting and publishes selected material only.

translation: Complete English translation of the supplied page.

diplomatic_latin: Diplomatic Latin preserving visible long s and genuine f.
normalized_latin: Normalized Latin kept distinct from the printed reading.
theological_loci: Theological loci supported by the supplied page.
exegetical_method: Exegetical method supported by the supplied page.

witness_comparison.limitation: No independent comparator could be inspected after the attempted research route.
